protocol.reference: Shiu et al. 2024 Nature whole-brain LIF (reimplemented, not copied - upstream repo ships no license)
protocol.drive: Poisson 10-260 Hz on the identified cell type/population
protocol.response_rule: sign of mean rate change vs the experiment's own baseline window, 95% CI separated across trials; no-effect iff CI includes zero AND point estimate < noise floor (95th pct |dRate| over unstimulated controls of the same target)

experiments.description: sugar/bitter GRN drive -> proboscis-feeding motor neuron MN9 rate increase
experiments.source: companion taste-feeding connectome paper (GRN->feeding-MN map); Shiu optogenetic validation

experiments.description: Johnston's-organ chordotonal drive -> downstream circuit activity increase (postsynaptic proxy for JON->grooming propagation; MaleCNS labels only the 65 cb_sensory grooming afferents, which are not JO-driven)
experiments.note: target finalized at pilot: JO's direct postsynaptic partners; the grooming subclass resolves to sensory afferents only
